question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"occurred."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Occurred"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits in the context of the sentence.
 
• The word **"Occurred"** means to happen or take place. (कुछ घटित हो जाना (प्रायः अचानक))
 
• It is a past tense form of the verb **'occur.'**
